sourceSummary.zh: 文章专门展开“三条腿的凳子”中的再投资：企业赚到的钱，能否继续以高回报投入，决定复利能够延续多久。
sourceSummary.en: The article develops reinvestment within the three-legged stool: whether retained earnings can continue earning attractive returns determines the compounding runway.

heading.zh: 再投资是让已经赚到的钱继续工作
heading.en: Reinvestment puts earned cash back to work

paragraphs.zh: 文章从企业管理者面对的现金分配选择切入：把盈利留在企业继续投入，或者作为股息分给股东。阿克雷把前一种选择与复利联系起来。关键在于，留存资金能否继续增加企业的经济价值；“留存”与“高回报地再投入”需要一并考察。
paragraphs.en: Akre begins with management’s choice between retaining cash and distributing dividends. He connects the first with compounding. The important question is whether retained funds continue increasing economic value; retention and productive reinvestment must be assessed together.

heading.zh: 21% 的企业回报，为什么可能只对应 7% 的股息收益
heading.en: Why a 21% business return can yield only 7% in dividends

paragraphs.zh: 原文的例子是：企业资本回报率为 21%，股东以投入资本的 3 倍价格买入，若全部利润分红，股息收益率就是 21% ÷ 3 = 7%。企业内部资本与股东支付的市价，是两个不同的分母。若利润能够持续按原有高回报再投资，企业资本和利润的增长则会形成另一条回报路径；原文为此保留了买入估值合理、再投资机会能够持续等条件。
paragraphs.en: His example pairs a 21% capital return with a purchase price of three times invested capital. Full distribution then produces a 7% dividend yield. Business capital and the shareholder’s purchase price are different denominators. Reinvestment offers a different path through growth, subject to reasonable valuation and a continuing runway.

heading.zh: 再投资能力要看具体去向

paragraphs.zh: 文章列出并购、固定资产与存货投入，以及跨资产类别配置等不同路径。这补全了“优秀管理层”的含义：既要经营好现有业务，也要判断新增资本放在哪里。阅读时最值得抓住的连接，是好生意产生现金，管理者分配现金，再投资机会让这套过程继续。
paragraphs.en: The article identifies acquisitions, operating investment and allocation across asset classes as distinct routes. Management must both run existing operations and choose uses for incremental capital. The central connection joins cash-generating businesses, capital allocators and opportunities to repeat the process.
